error[ZBX-E0607]: --listen takes 127.0.0.1 and a port from 1 to 65535
  while  checking --listen
  cause  --listen '10.0.0.1:8080': the address is not 127.0.0.1, the only
         address a listener may have
  fix    give the loopback address and a port:   zbx run --listen 127.0.0.1:8080 --listen-send 3 alpine -- sh
  more   zbx explain E0607
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0607.html
